description: (Na)₂RbGaF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a RbGaF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the RbGaF₆ framework, Rb is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RbF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rb-F bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RbF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-F bond lengths are 1.92 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Rb and one Ga atom.
